acceptance.crps: paired compound-block superiority to every mandatory probabilistic baseline
acceptance.joint_energy_and_effect_rmse: both within a 2% paired relative noninferiority margin of the best applicable mandatory baseline and at least one strictly superior

metrics.formula: mean over wells and train-selected features of E|X-Y|-0.5E|X-X'| after panel-only log1p(10000*count_i/panel_total_2000)
mean over wells of E||X-Y||_2-0.5E||X-X'||_2 in a projection fit on train only after the panel-only scoring transform
RMSE of predicted versus observed treated-minus-same-plate-vehicle mean panel-logCP10k effects
absolute empirical marginal coverage error from nominal 0.50 on the panel-logCP10k untouched-test values
absolute empirical marginal coverage error from nominal 0.80 on the panel-logCP10k untouched-test values
absolute empirical marginal coverage error from nominal 0.95 on the panel-logCP10k untouched-test values
mean central 50% panel-logCP10k predictive interval width on untouched test wells
mean central 80% panel-logCP10k predictive interval width on untouched test wells
mean central 95% panel-logCP10k predictive interval width on untouched test wells
equal-compound mean RMSE over the four exact-dose vehicle-relative panel-logCP10k pseudobulk profiles

missingness: Every expected well is required; an absent target is an error and never silently dropped.
predictive_interval_calibration: Any interval-calibration parameters are fit only on the calibration partition; coverage error and width are reported on untouched test wells.
scoring_transform_rule: For each observed or predicted sample, panel_total is the sum of exactly the declared ordered 2,000 raw counts and each coordinate becomes log1p(10000*count_i/panel_total). No full-axis denominator is read. A wrong length/order, nonfinite/noninteger/negative count, or panel_total<=0 is a fatal evaluation error with no exclusion or imputation.
uncertainty: Multiway bootstrap by compound and whole protected plate; cells are never independent resampling units.
